meta.name: agent-supply-chain
meta.description:
Verify supply chain integrity for AI agent plugins, tools, and dependencies. Use this skill when:
- Generating SHA-256 integrity manifests for agent plugins or tool packages
- Verifying that installed plugins match their published manifests
- Detecting tampered, modified, or untracked files in agent tool directories
- Auditing dependency pinning and version policies for agent components
- Building provenance chains for agent plugin promotion (dev → staging → production)
- Any request like "verify plugin integrity", "generate manifest", "check supply chain", or "sign this plugin"

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 可以生成并验证 AI agent 插件的完整性清单，检测文件是否被篡改，审计依赖版本固定情况，并检查插件是否准备好从开发环境推广到生产环境。
howto.when: 当你提到“验证插件完整性”、“生成清单”或“检查供应链”等关键词，或要求对插件进行推广前检查时触发。

say.text: 验证我的插件目录完整性。
say.note: Claude 会生成哈希并与现有清单比对，报告是否篡改。

say.text: 生成当前插件 SHA-256 完整性清单。
审计插件依赖的版本是否固定。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can generate and verify SHA-256 integrity manifests for AI agent plugins, detect tampered/modified/untracked files, audit dependency version pinning, and gate plugin promotion from development to production.
howto.when_en: When you request actions like "verify plugin integrity", "generate manifest", "check supply chain", or ask to promote a plugin, or during CI steps, code review, or pre-promotion checks.

say_en.text: Verify the integrity of my plugin directory.
say_en.note: Claude will hash files and compare against existing manifest.

say_en.text: Generate an SHA-256 integrity manifest for the current plugin.
say_en.note: Claude will create an INTEGRITY.json with file hashes.

say_en.text: Audit if plugin dependencies are pinned to exact versions.
say_en.note: Claude checks package.json or requirements.txt for loose versions.
